Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 12
, Reason for Mistake: Misread the Treccani entry by conflating the place of arrest/camp (Cascina) with the place of execution/death. Paolo Vitelli was executed in the courtyard of the Palazzo della Signoria in Florence, not in Cascina. The WebSurfer incorrectly stated “a Cascina,” leading the Planner to conclude the wrong death place.
